newsitem.title: USA: Rubin to visit Japan early next month.
newsitem.headline: Rubin to visit Japan early next month.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin plans to visit Japan during a six-day trip early next month that will also take him to the Philippines and Vietnam, Treasury officials said on Wednesday.
While in Tokyo, Rubin is expected to meet Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka and other senior government officials to discuss Japan's economy and financial reforms.
The Treasury chief will stop over in Tokyo on April 4 on his way to a meeting in the Philippines of Asia-Pacific finance ministers and a visit to Vietnam.
